description: Full turnkey cost of importing a car from Germany / another EU country (e.g. a mobile.de or AutoScout24 listing) to Portugal through TransparentCars: car price + transport + paperwork (inspection, IMT, plates) + TransparentCars service + ISV, as one total, with the yearly IUC road tax shown apart. Handles net/gross VAT: if the dealer listing shows deductible VAT (two prices, e.g. '€36,958 Net, 19% VAT' / 'MwSt. ausweisbar'), pass vat='gross' — the German VAT is removed and Portuguese IVA 23% applied to the net price. Private sellers / margin-scheme cars: vat='final'. An estimate (final ISV is set by the tax authority from the COC). For the tax alone use calculate_isv.

cc.description: Engine displacement in cm³ (0 for electric)

fuel.description: petrol, diesel, hybrid, hybrid_diesel, phev, electric, lpg

price.description: Price on the listing in EUR, e.g. 19500

range_km.description: Electric range in km (plug-in hybrids: >=50 km gives the 75% ISV reduction)

used.description: Used (true, default) or new (false: up to 6 months / 6,000 km)

vat.description: How to read price: final (default; private seller / margin scheme, no VAT line), gross (dealer price incl. deductible seller-country VAT), net (price without VAT)

vat_rate.description: Seller-country VAT % for vat=gross (DE 19 default, AT 20, IT 22, ES 21, FR 20, NL 21, BE 21)

name: calculate_import_cost
